findings.evidence: Artin.lean:245-249 `theorem natCard_nsmul_mem_indVirtualCharacters_isCyclic {f : G → k} (hf : ...)` under `variable {k} {G} [Field k] [Group G]` / `variable [Finite G]` (lines 130-131) — no `IsAlgClosed`/`CharZero` in scope; Ideal.lean:194-196 `indVirtualCharactersBaseChangeRat_surjective (P) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (h : ∀ f ∈ virtualCharacters k G, n • f ∈ indVirtualCharacters k G P)`.
findings.fix: Drop both instance binders and the detour: `theorem indVirtualCharactersBaseChangeRat_surjective_isCyclic : Function.Surjective (indVirtualCharactersBaseChangeRat k G (fun C ↦ IsCyclic C)) := indVirtualCharactersBaseChangeRat_surjective _ (Nat.card G) Nat.card_pos.ne' fun _ hf ↦ natCard_nsmul_mem_indVirtualCharacters_isCyclic hf`. findings.issue: `indVirtualCharactersBaseChangeRat_surjective_isCyclic` is exposed with `[CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k]`, but the statement holds for any field: it follows from `natCard_nsmul_mem_indVirtualCharacters_isCyclic` (Artin.lean:245, hypotheses `[Field k] [Group G] [Finite G]` only) via `indVirtualCharactersBaseChangeRat_surjective` (Ideal.lean:194, needs only `n ≠ 0` and the membership). The binders are used solely by lines 323-326, which apply `indVirtualCharacterSpan_le_indVirtualCharacters` and then `rw [← indVirtualCharacters_eq_indVirtualCharacterSpan ...]`, restoring the original goal. Net effect: the headline rational Artin map theorem cannot be used at `k = ℚ` or `k = ℝ`.

findings.issue: Same defect in `indVirtualCharactersBaseChangeRat_surjective_isElementary`: `[CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k]` are needed only by the identical no-op span round trip at lines 360-363, while `natCard_nsmul_mem_indVirtualCharacters_isElementary` (line 346) assumes nothing about `k`.

summary: The exposed surface is minimal and well characterized, but the two rational-surjectivity theorems carry `[CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k]` hypotheses that nothing in their content needs, so they are inapplicable at k = ℚ or k = ℝ; the module docstring repeats the false restriction.
